name: pi-subagents
notes: Forked from nicobailon/pi-subagents; local compatibility fixes preserve @xzzpig/pi-permission-system priority in resolvePermissionSystemExtension() (now in src/runs/shared/child-tool-plan.ts). Fleet native transcript (openspec fleet-native-transcript): src/tui/fleet-native-transcript.ts (JSONL→shared-library entries adapter + Pi-native renderer via guarded dynamic import of @xzzpig/pi-components/transcript), wiring in src/tui/fleet.ts (renderer mode cache branch, v/V toggleRenderer keybinding, legacy fallback), @xzzpig/pi-components bundled via bundledDependencies (private, never published), and shared readTranscriptRecords export in src/tui/fleet-transcript.ts. Fork-only additions: context injection (src/extension/context-injection.ts, injectToContext frontmatter field, subagents.injectAgents setting, doctor reporting) and the shared agent-eject API (src/api/agent-management.ts, ejectAgentDefinition) used by pi-goal-x. The old Pi SDK streamFn option-naming divergence was dropped: upstream ships agentStreamOptions() dual-name handling. v0.68.0 sync adopted upstream's removal of fallbackModels / same-launch model switching / persistent model exclusions (do not re-port the fork's multi-model loop onto execution.ts or subagent-runner.ts), upstream's herdr pane-native placement plus the src/inspectors/herdr collapse, and upstream's createCapturedChildHooks / buildRunnerChildLaunch / resolveLaunchBinding architecture; the fork's sandbox-profile and permission-profile threading (RunnerSubagentStep.sandbox/permissionProfile, LaunchBindingSource fields, resolveSandboxExtension, preflight untrusted_project validation) must be re-applied on each future sync. Known accepted lint debt after the v0.68.0 sync: pi-lens reports ~72 blocking findings across ~40 files dominated by no-unknown-returns, require-safety-comment-for-as-unknown-as, unchecked-throwing-call, and error-swallowing on upstream-original code, plus known false positives (TS1470 import.meta on ESM sources, Vite-style query-string imports in async-spawn-package-dir.test.ts); by decision on 2026-09-17 the fork keeps upstream code byte-identical instead of adding per-site inline suppressions, so the findings are recorded as accepted debt and re-checked on the next sync rather than fixed in-tree.
